headline: Chipotle Plans Further Expansion in Mexico City and Nuevo León
summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill confirmed plans to open additional restaurants across Mexico City and the state of Nuevo León, following a stronger-than-expected consumer reception during its initial market entry.
why: Chipotle is a major US fast-casual restaurant chain; successfully expanding into international Latin American markets represents a key new growth avenue.

impacts.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc.
impacts.why: Demonstrated traction in Mexico validates the brand's international multi-unit store expansion model.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
